quests.instruction: What number comes right before 20?
quests.hint: The number right before is always one less than the number you're on.
quests.explanation: Counting backward, the number right before 20 is 19 -- one less than 20!
quests.funFact: The number 19 has two digits: a 1 in the tens place and a 9 in the ones place!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.question: Twenty
quests.hint: Break the word into parts -- does it sound like a small number, a "teen", or a bigger one?
quests.explanation: "Twenty" is how we say the number 20 in English, so 20 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: The word 'Twenty' has exactly 6 letters in it!

quests.instruction: Which number is smaller: 16 or 17?
quests.question: 16 or 17
quests.hint: Picture counting all the way up -- whichever number you'd reach first is the answer.
quests.explanation: 16 is smaller than 17 -- when counting up, 16 comes earlier!
quests.funFact: If you count backwards, 16 comes just before 17!

quests.instruction: Is 13 an odd number or an even number?
quests.hint: Look at the very last digit of 13 -- is it 0, 2, 4, 6, or 8?
quests.explanation: 13 cannot be split into two equal groups -- there's always one left over, so 13 is Odd!
quests.funFact: A baker's dozen is a friendly extra treat -- 13 instead of 12!

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 12 or 13?
quests.question: 12 or 13
quests.hint: Compare the digits from left to right: which number has more value?
quests.explanation: 13 is greater than 12 -- when counting up, 13 comes later!
quests.funFact: Double 13 is 26! Because 13 + 13 = 26.

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.question: Twenty-Five
quests.hint: Break the word into parts -- does it sound like a small number, a "teen", or a bigger one?
quests.explanation: "Twenty-Five" is how we say the number 25 in English, so 25 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: If you count backwards, 25 comes just before 26!

quests.instruction: Which word describes position number 10 in a line?
quests.hint: Think of a race -- this word describes exactly which place a runner finished in.
quests.explanation: Position 10 in a line is called the "Tenth" position -- ordinal words describe order, not amount!
quests.funFact: You have exactly 10 fingers and 10 toes all together!

quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Read the numeral 15 out loud -- what word do you say?
quests.explanation: The numeral 15 is written in words as "Fifteen" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: A basketball shot clock in some leagues once counted down from 15!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.question: Seventeen
quests.hint: Sound the word out slowly, then count that many fingers to check.
quests.explanation: "Seventeen" is how we say the number 17 in English, so 17 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: Double 17 is 34! Because 17 + 17 = 34.

quests.instruction: Which number is smaller: 24 or 13?
quests.question: 24 or 13
quests.hint: Line the numbers up on a number line in your head -- further left is smaller.
quests.explanation: 13 is smaller than 24 -- when counting up, 13 comes earlier!
quests.funFact: If you multiply 13 by 10, it becomes 130!

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 24, 17, or 20?
quests.hint: Compare them two at a time, then keep the bigger one.
quests.explanation: Out of 24, 17, and 20, the number 24 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: If you add 0 to 24, it stays exactly the same: 24!

quests.instruction: What number comes between 20 and 22?
quests.question: 20 and 22
quests.hint: This number sits right in the middle, one more than 20 and one less than 22.
quests.explanation: 21 sits exactly between 20 and 22 -- one step up from 20 and one step down from 22!
quests.funFact: The number 21 is an odd number!

quests.instruction: Is 24 an odd number or an even number?
quests.hint: Look at the very last digit of 24 -- is it 0, 2, 4, 6, or 8?
quests.explanation: 24 can be split into two equal groups with nothing left over, so 24 is Even!
quests.funFact: A full day and night together lasts exactly 24 hours!

quests.instruction: Which word describes position number 1 in a line?
quests.hint: This word tells you WHERE something is in line, not how many there are in total.
quests.explanation: Position 1 in a line is called the "First" position -- ordinal words describe order, not amount!
quests.funFact: You have exactly 1 nose and 1 belly button!

quests.instruction: What number comes right before 18?
quests.hint: Start at 18 and step one number backward.
quests.explanation: Counting backward, the number right before 18 is 17 -- one less than 18!
quests.funFact: The number 17 has two digits: a 1 in the tens place and a 7 in the ones place!

quests.instruction: What number comes between 23 and 25?
quests.question: 23 and 25
quests.hint: Say the numbers in order: 23, then ..., then 25.
quests.explanation: 24 sits exactly between 23 and 25 -- one step up from 23 and one step down from 25!
quests.funFact: If you count up by ones, 24 comes right after 23!

quests.instruction: What number comes right after 20?
quests.hint: Start at 20 and take just one more step forward.
quests.explanation: Counting forward, the number right after 20 is 21 -- one more than 20!
quests.funFact: If you count backwards, 21 comes just before 22!

quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Look at how many digits 14 has, then think of how that word usually sounds.
quests.explanation: The numeral 14 is written in words as "Fourteen" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: Valentine's Day always lands on the 14th day of February!

quests.instruction: What number comes right before 25?
quests.hint: Start at 25 and step one number backward.
quests.explanation: Counting backward, the number right before 25 is 24 -- one less than 25!
quests.funFact: Double 24 is 48! Because 24 + 24 = 48.

quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Look at how many digits 22 has, then think of how that word usually sounds.
quests.explanation: The numeral 22 is written in words as "Twenty-Two" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: Counting one by one from 1, you would say 22 exactly 22 numbers into your count!

quests.instruction: Is 15 an odd number or an even number?
quests.hint: Try to share 15 things between two friends equally -- does anyone get a leftover?
quests.explanation: 15 cannot be split into two equal groups -- there's always one left over, so 15 is Odd!
quests.funFact: A basketball shot clock in some leagues once counted down from 15!

quests.instruction: What number comes between 18 and 20?
quests.question: 18 and 20
quests.hint: Say the numbers in order: 18, then ..., then 20.
quests.explanation: 19 sits exactly between 18 and 20 -- one step up from 18 and one step down from 20!
quests.funFact: If you add 1 to 19, you get 20!

quests.instruction: What number comes right before 17?
quests.hint: The number right before is always one less than the number you're on.
quests.explanation: Counting backward, the number right before 17 is 16 -- one less than 17!
quests.funFact: If you had 16 apples and found one more, you would have 17 apples!

quests.instruction: Which number is smaller: 24 or 15?
quests.question: 24 or 15
quests.hint: Compare the digits from left to right: which number has more value?
quests.explanation: 15 is smaller than 24 -- when counting up, 15 comes earlier!
quests.funFact: If you multiply 15 by 10, it becomes 150!

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 17, 13, or 15?
quests.hint: The greatest number is the one you'd reach last while counting up from zero.
quests.explanation: Out of 17, 13, and 15, the number 17 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: If you add 0 to 17, it stays exactly the same: 17!

quests.instruction: What number comes right before 12?
quests.hint: The number right before is always one less than the number you're on.
quests.explanation: Counting backward, the number right before 12 is 11 -- one less than 12!
quests.funFact: The number 11 is an odd number!

quests.instruction: Which number is smaller: 19 or 22?
quests.question: 19 or 22
quests.hint: Picture counting all the way up -- whichever number you'd reach first is the answer.
quests.explanation: 19 is smaller than 22 -- when counting up, 19 comes earlier!
quests.funFact: The number 19 has two digits: a 1 in the tens place and a 9 in the ones place!

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 19, 20, or 14?
quests.hint: Compare them two at a time, then keep the bigger one.
quests.explanation: Out of 19, 20, and 14, the number 20 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: If you count up by ones, 20 comes right after 19!

quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Count up to 16 in your head, saying each number word as you go.
quests.explanation: The numeral 16 is written in words as "Sixteen" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: In many places, 16 is celebrated as a big birthday milestone!

quests.instruction: Is 24 an odd number or an even number?
quests.hint: Count by twos (2, 4, 6, 8...) -- does 24 ever land exactly on one of those steps?
quests.explanation: 24 can be split into two equal groups with nothing left over, so 24 is Even!
quests.funFact: A full day and night together lasts exactly 24 hours!
